description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to develop a strategy to guide Loango National Parks conservation and research activities; use protected area management planning tools to ensure optimum implementation; provide capacity building and equipment to staff for effective operations; and ensure that ecotourism products and activities are well-planned across the landscape. The project will: 1) Implement a clear strategy to guide Loango National Park Project's conservation and research activities. Activities include employing a short-term technical expert to review all project activities. 2) Use protected area management planning tools effectively to ensure optimum implementation across Loango National Park. Activities include: providing technical support to the Loango project manager on long-term planning tools such as the annual work plan; and ensuring that critical threats to the park are regularly monitored and assessed. 3) Ensure effective operations through capacity and equipment resources for staff. Activities include: providing technical support to ensure that personnel management systems are in place, providing necessary field equipment, communication systems and operational resources to implement critical field activities; ensuring that necessary systems, inventories and management procedures are in place to safeguard, store and deploy equipment; coordinate implementation of short-term work plans and ensure effective communication with key project staff.
